brief:
The Prisoners' Defense Center reported that approximately 370 Palestinian children are currently detained in Israeli prisons, according to Shehab Wire. The figure represents the center's assessment of the total number of minors held across the Israeli prison system at present.

The report did not specify the ages of the detained children, their locations within the prison network, or the charges they face. The Prisoners' Defense Center has long documented cases of Palestinian minors in Israeli custody, though comprehensive data on individual cases remains difficult to verify independently.
